comment: None of this module's jacks carries a name in the installed build: the maker added input and output tooltips in the commit after this one, so hovering a jack here shows nothing. The maker's README calls this module experimental and warns that its behaviour may change. The coupling type knob picks between two fixed coupling curves and crossfades between them rather than switching.
